headline: President Trump signed an executive order on March 25, 2025, aimed at the national law firm Jenner & Block.
what_it_does: The order is directed at the law firm Jenner & Block. Its title says it addresses risks the administration links to the firm. No summary was provided, so the specific actions the order takes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Jenner & Block, its lawyers, and its staff
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at this firm, though the details of how it affects them were not included in the source material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 25, 2025; the source material gives no specific effective date.
